main_text.head: CAP. IX.
De obedientia Christianorum in Aurelianum Persequutione nonâ grassante.
main_text.p: Totus erat Aurelianus eo præsertim tempore quo adversus Marcomannos in Italiam irrumpentes expeditionem pararet, in consulendis Libris fatidicis Sybillinis; de quibus inspiciendis, cunctantem Senatum literis sic admonuit: „Vopiscus in vita. Aureliani.{e}miror vos Patres tam diu de aperiendis Sybillinis dubitasse Libris, quasi in Christianorum Ecclesia, non in Templo Deorum omnium tractaretis.“ Ex quibus Aureliani verbis, non inepte colligendum arbitror, nonnullos fuisse tunc temporis in ipso Senatu Romano Christianos, qui cæteris in evolvendis codicibus Sybillinis pro suo modulo obnisi sunt: præsertim cū Senatum, etiam suo tempore Christianis repletum, anteà ex Tertulliano demonstraverimus. page.notes: The left margin note carries the reference mark "e" and reads "Vopiscus in vita. Aureliani." The mark "e" in the text is printed as a superscript and is placed in braces. The right-hand strip of the neighbouring page is cut off and is not transcribed. The word "Christianos,qui" has its r printed in a closed form that is hard to read; it is transcribed as "Christianos,qui". The initial T of the first paragraph is a large woodcut-style letter, joined to "otus".
